name: Astral Ltd
about: Astral Poly Technik Ltd was established in 1996, with the aim to manufacture pro-India plumbing and drainage systems in the country. The company is into manufacturing of Pipes, water tanks, bathware, specialised valves, paints, adhesives and sealants, infrastructure solutions, specialised fittings and construction chemicals.

items.quote: 4% in H1 against the company's guidance of double -digit volume growth and 16% -18% margin.
Similarly, if you see the margin side also, we have given a guidance of 16%-18% EBITDA.
So last year, if you see out of INR916 crores EBITDA, which we have delivered in the full year basis, the first half was INR369 crores and the second half was INR547 crores.
We are expecting the similar kind of growth, so we will be easily doing close to a bout INR1,050 crores kind of EBITDA in the full year basis.
As we guided in last call that we will be closing full year with 20%, 25% kind of growth.
And if that is the case, our value growth for the full year will be more than 20%, in top line.
So this quarter and maybe then the full year, can we see a mid kind of a 15% kind of a growth that is more likely kind of achievable?
And at the same time, in terms of the margin, because we in plumbing used to guide 16% to 18%, but this quarter also 18.9%.

guidance.note: Numeric forward-looking lines found in the latest transcripts. Verdicts need the extraction step (set a model key) or a cached extraction.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 15.6% a year over 5 years
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 160% of PAT over 3 years

bear.text: Growth is slowing: revenue 8.4% a year over 3 years vs 15.6% over 5
Profit lagged sales (5.6% vs 15.6% a year), so margins compressed

items.quote: The overall Q1 value growth is 15.9% and with the EBITDA margin of 15.5%.

claims.summary: The one company-wide figure management read out on the last 2 calls matches the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 161% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 26 days to pay, against 25 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 2% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 3% while operating profit grew 12%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 26%, against 26% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.08× equity, against 0.06× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 54.2%, unchanged over the last 4 reported quarters.
